blurb: Guests can enjoy climbing adventures with 16 unique climbing elements including rock faces up to 45 feet tall, bag jumps, and cargo monkey bridges. The Adventure Nets feature seven treehouses connected by tunnels, bridges, and ladders up to 40 feet high. Birthday parties and corporate events are also offered with various packages including attractions, food, and drinks.
extraNote: 10% gratuity and sales tax apply to party packages · Highly advised to book in advance due to capacity limits · Sales & Events office open Mon-Fri 9am-5pm for corporate event planning
